viewer.label.description: The screen reader's name of the media viewer, a dialog over the page that shows a post's pictures and videos whole, one at a time.

viewer.position.description: Which of a post's media the viewer shows, such as 2 of 4, at the start of its bar; a screen reader announces it each time the reader moves to another. Not shown for a single picture.

viewer.shown.description: What a screen reader announces when the reader moves to another of a post's media in the media viewer: where it is among them (viewer.position) and the start of its description (alternative text), in any language, cut short with … when long.

viewer.shown_kind.defaultMessage: {count} 件中 {index} 件目、{kind, select, gifv {GIF} video {動画} other {画像}}
viewer.shown_kind.description: What a screen reader announces when the reader moves to another of a post's media in the media viewer and it has no description: where it is among them (viewer.position) and its kind; gifv is a short silent loop.

viewer.close.description: The button that closes the media viewer.

viewer.previous.description: The button of the media viewer that shows the post's previous picture or video.

viewer.next.description: The button of the media viewer that shows the post's next picture or video.

viewer.zoom_in.description: The button of the media viewer that zooms into the picture.

viewer.zoom_out.description: The button of the media viewer, while zoomed into a picture, that shows the whole picture again.
